text.en:
COMOLAS GALEANE
located in the Province o Romblon on condition that all
the unpaid taxes and peunities corresponding to 1.951 and
previous years and the remaining 50 per cent of the 1952
taxes shall be paid on or before December 81, 1952.
Done in the City of Manila, this 28th day of October, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-two, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the seventh.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
4223
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
